culture-cycles.note: Holidays treated like Sundays under the cantonal rest-day laws (SECO table). The 1 August national day is the only federal holiday. Holidays on a Sunday are not moved.

laws.rule: Ticino charges one uniform stay tax (tassa di soggiorno) per night across the canton, set by category (executive decree on tourist taxes, art. 1, from 1 January 2025): CHF 4.50 in 4 and 5 star hotels (about A$7.77); CHF 4.20 in 1 to 3 star or unrated hotels (about A$7.26); CHF 2.00 in rooms, apartments and holiday homes (about A$3.45) and in lodgings sold through online portals that collect directly; CHF 3.10 at campsites, motorhome sites and youth hostels (about A$5.36); CHF 0.50 in huts and group lodgings (about A$0.86). The host adds it to the bill as a separate line and collects it (art. 12 of the tourism regulation). A separate promotion tax also applies to businesses. AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = CHF 0.5789.
